summary.short: Creates the Louisiana crime (R.S. 14:73.14) of disseminating or selling AI-created nude or sexually explicit images of another person without authorization, with intent to coerce, harass, intimidate or maliciously disseminate. Sets penalties and exempts certain internet and telecommunications intermediaries.
summary.long: Enacts R.S. 14:73.14 (Section 1) creating the crime of unlawful dissemination or sale of images of another created by artificial intelligence. Subsection A makes it unlawful for any person, with intent to coerce, harass, intimidate, or maliciously disseminate or sell, an AI-created video or still image depicting another person totally nude or in a state of undress exposing genitals, pubic area, buttocks, or female breast, where the person knows or has reason to know they are not licensed or authorized to do so. Subsection C defines another person (including a recognizable depiction of an actual person), artificial intelligence, electronic mail service provider and interactive computer service. Subsection B excludes listed interactive computer, email, telecommunications and information service providers and access software providers whose multi-user computer service was used by a person to commit a prohibited act. Subsection D sets the penalty: imprisonment for not more than six months, a fine of not more than seven hundred fifty dollars, or both. Subsection E allows prosecution in the parish where the act occurred or where the image was created, produced, reproduced, found, stored, received or possessed. Subsection F states that the section does not preclude civil actions or prosecutions under other law. The text contains no effective date provision.

relations.note: Subsection B exempts providers of any information service as defined in 47 U.S.C. 153. The federal definition is incorporated by reference and is not reproduced in the text.

relations.note: Venue for prosecution under this Section is stated in addition to any venue provided by the Code of Criminal Procedure. The text does not amend that code.

notes: The document contains only Section 1 (enacting R.S. 14:73.14). No Section 2, effective-date clause or sunset appears in the fetched text, so no effective date is recorded. Subsection B's exemption list uses terms that Subsection C(4) defines differently (e.g., 'interactive computer service' is defined as 'information service, system, or access software provider'). The penalty in D and venue in E belong in enforcement and are not coded here.

evidence.quote: "Another person" includes a person whose image was used in creating, adapting, or modifying a video or still image

"Artificial intelligence" means an artificial system developed in computer software, physical hardware, or other context that solves tasks requiring human-like perception, cognition, planning, learning, communication, or physical action.
means any person or entity, including an internet service provider, that is an intermediary in sending or receiving electronic mail
means any information service, system, or access software provider that provides or enables computer access by multiple users to a computer server
any information service as defined in 47 U.S.C.153

obligations.summary: Makes it unlawful for any person to disseminate or sell an AI-created video or still image depicting another person nude or in undress, with intent to coerce, harass, intimidate, or maliciously disseminate or sell, where the person knows or has reason to know they are not licensed or authorized to do so.
obligations.conditional_on: Intent to coerce, harass, intimidate, or maliciously disseminate or sell; the person knows or has reason to know that he is not licensed or authorized to disseminate or sell the image; the image depicts another person totally nude or in a state of undress exposing the genitals, pubic area, buttocks, or female breast.

evidence.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person, with the intent to coerce, harass, intimidate, or maliciously disseminate or sell any video or still image created by artificial intelligence
